node.title: Rate-half ordinary-list adjacent crossing
node.statement: For every admissible official rate-1/2 row, with B*=floor(|F|/2^128) and ordinary worst-list size L_1(a), find a_L(C) such that L_1(a_L(C)) <= B* < L_1(a_L(C)-1). The complete branches B*=1,2 are now exact at a_L=3n/4. At the prize-max razor row the cyclic floor and exact-integer Johnson theorem prove k+2^34 <= a_L(C) <= a_IJ(C) on the remaining B*>=3 branches. Arbitrary constant interleaving arity is handled later by list_large_m_scope_closure. || BUDGET-THREE BOUNDED EDGE GEOMETRY (wave-11 audited, 2026-07-18): budgets B* in {1,2} are now a COMPLETE list-prize determination at a_L = 3n/4 — every common-support interleaving arity m >= 1 (rate_half_list_low_budget_all_arity_crossing, resting on the exact-crossing node + the interleaving collapse L1 <= 2 => L1^2 < q). BUDGET 3: any hypothetical 4-codeword witness at the Johnson predecessor 3n/4 - 1 reduces (six-matrix reduction -> split-pencil normal form -> Plucker gate) to EXACTLY 13 chambers — 9 base-field split-unit Grassmann-line chambers (exceptional degrees {3,4,5,6,8}) + 4 balanced Grassmann scrolls whose rank-deficient branch is EMPTY (det C = b01^2(L12 L03 - L02 L13) != 0); the fourth-member residue is closed; BOTH censuses machine-enumerated AND independently re-enumerated at audit. OPEN: official-subgroup arithmetic in the 13 chambers; a full close moves the safe endpoint by exactly ONE step — the proved B*=3 bracket [k+2^34, 3n/4] is NOT moved by this classification (w10-H5-mirror note). Full pin bodies in the node folder. PIN DETAIL (verifier contract): the reduction factors any witness into the six incidence types of 4-wise RS agreement matrices; the split-pencil normal form is A_k b_ij+A_i b_jk=A_j b_ik with entries of degree at most two; the Plucker gate is b_01b_23-b_02b_13+b_03b_12=0 with edge polynomials of degree at most four. || WAVE-12 NOTE (2026-07-18): the single-fiber split-unit exclusion kills one construction ROUTE in all nine line chambers (each supported locator = one degree-d quotient fiber minus exceptional points; unconditional at official fields) — it closes ZERO chambers (the commit title overstates, w12-C2); the maximal-field degree collapse is maximal-row-only (n=2^41, e in {1,2}, unique cubic candidate 5*2^41+1 divisible by 7); chamber scoreboard: 0/13 closed, 13/13 further reduced.
